title: Contentful CMA personal access token documented CFPAT- placeholders, references, masks and bare Bearer scheme
summary: The Contentful-maintained placeholders CFPAT-123...789 and CFPAT-xxx, the documented Bearer <token> form, a bare scheme, an environment reference and a masked display.
rationale: Two repositories maintained by Contentful write the CMA token placeholder as CFPAT- followed by dots or x characters (claim provider-placeholders-begin-cfpat); a placeholder states a leading string only and is not a value. The documented Bearer <token> form, a bare scheme, a reference and a mask also carry no value. The CFPAT- placeholders are provider-published values (option 3 of the synthetic-value rules, linked by the cited sources). Flagging them would redact documentation a reader needs; the case does not say CFPAT- applies to every issued token.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, redact-secret#1228 Group C). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: the values here are provider-maintained placeholders, the documented Bearer form, references or masks, not credential values; that such forms are not values is a project decision. Contentful-maintained repositories write the placeholders; the API reference writes Bearer <token>.

sources.supports: Bearer authentication of the form Bearer <token>, where token is your auth token.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
